entry.title: CVE-2026-92161: Unverified Discord email trusted by FriendsOfFlarum OAuth
entry.summary: FriendsOfFlarum OAuth's Discord provider could treat an unverified email address as trusted identity evidence. The CVE description reports that this can enable takeover of an existing Flarum account, including an administrator account. An isolated regression confirmed the email-trust flaw in fof/oauth 1.7.3 and its correction in 1.7.4. End-to-end account takeover through live Discord authentication remains unverified by this research.

entry.title: CVE-2026-87902: WordPress page-template traversal and local PHP inclusion
entry.summary: An unauthenticated path traversal vulnerability in WordPress page-template resolution can include a readable local PHP file outside the active theme directories when specific theme prerequisites are met. The project advisory rates the issue Critical, with CVSS v4.0 9.2, and describes conditional remote code execution. Independent laboratory validation reproduced the inclusion primitive on WordPress 7.1.1; the same behavior was not reproduced on WordPress 7.1.2. Command execution was not attempted.

entry.title: CVE-2026-82377: Cross-weblog missing authorization in Apache Roller XML-RPC APIs
entry.summary: Apache Roller 6.1.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in its legacy Blogger and MetaWeblog XML-RPC APIs. The upstream description reports that authenticated users can read, modify, or delete content belonging to other weblogs when global XML-RPC support is enabled. An isolated local authorization regression test confirmed an authorization failure in 6.1.5 and the expected denial in 6.1.6. The reported severity is Critical, with CVSS v3.1 score 9.9 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H).

entry.title: CVE-2026-77244: Unauthenticated operator-credential fallback in MCP Atlassian
entry.summary: MCP Atlassian versions before 0.22.0 are reported to accept HTTP requests without a verified user identity and fall back to globally configured operator credentials. An isolated local regression confirmed that v0.21.1 forwarded an unauthenticated request to the downstream application and returned a global Jira fetcher in the fallback check. Version 0.22.0 rejected the tested request with HTTP 401 and blocked the fallback. Successful Atlassian read or write operations were not independently demonstrated.

entry.title: CVE-2026-59971: MySQL MCP Server SSE transport lacks Host validation
entry.summary: MySQL MCP Server before 0.4.2 is reported to expose unauthenticated database operations when SSE transport is enabled and to lack DNS-rebinding protection. An isolated regression test independently confirmed that v0.4.1 accepted a forged Host value while v0.4.2 rejected it with MCP SDK 1.30.0. This establishes the Host-validation primitive; database access and browser-mediated exploitation were not reproduced. Default stdio transport is reported unaffected.

entry.title: CVE-2026-53710: Python sandbox isolation weakness in MCP Context Forge
entry.summary: CVE-2026-53710 affects the python_sandbox_server subproject of MCP Context Forge before version 1.0.2. Unrestricted attribute access and incomplete sandbox guards undermine Python code isolation. The upstream CVE description reports potential OS command execution through the execute_code tool. Laboratory control results establish a vulnerable-versus-patched configuration difference; runtime sandbox escape and command execution remain unverified. The core gateway and proxy components are not directly affected.
